preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 20000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(n.is_integer() and 2 <= n <= 300000 for n in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]])
preconditions.description: Each test case has an integer n (number of piranhas) between 2 and 300000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(a) == n and all(a_i.is_integer() and 1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a) for n, a in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]], [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2]]))
preconditions.description: Each test case has n integers a_i (piranha sizes) between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(output_line.is_integer() or output_line == -1 for output_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line is either an integer (index of a dominant piranha) or -1 (no dominant piranha).

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= output_line <= n if output_line != -1 else True for output_line, n in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]]))
postconditions.description: If the output is an index, it is between 1 and n (inclusive) for the corresponding test case.

postconditions.expression: all((output_line == -1 and not any(is_dominant(a, i) for i in range(1, n + 1))) or (output_line != -1 and is_dominant(a, output_line)) for output_line, n, a in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]], [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2]]))
postconditions.description: If the output is -1, there is no dominant piranha in the aquarium. If the output is an index, that piranha is dominant.
